title: 第157章 想用胶水粘脑袋第156章 小兔崽子你等着
slug: 娇娇挺孕肚死遁清冷师尊黑化了
content_zh:
谁知道他居然在装。
“那爹你打算怎么让他不好过呢？”宁楚有些好奇地问。
打不着，碰不到，难不成他打算找个道士来把裴昭给收了？
闻言，宁雄霸转头看她一眼，唇角勾起一抹阴险的笑，自鼻腔溢出一声轻哼，“你等着吧，仙人自有妙计。”
宁楚：“？”
她露出了个一言难尽的表情，这好像是以前的她的台词吧？
现在怎么变成别人说了？
说来也是好笑，她现在倒没什么俏皮的想法了，她觉得挺没意思的，还是成熟一些好。
反倒是其他人，好像越来越猥琐了。
半个时辰后，秦玖的客居。
她问顾玄要来一块木头，亲手给裴昭做了一块小小的灵位，跟巴掌差不多大，适合随身携带。
灵位做好之后，她又用宣纸叠了一把纸剑，裁了三套衣裳，还把衣裳仔仔细细地用颜料给上了色，最后往茶杯里添了点土充当香炉，然后点了三炷香插上去。
旋即拿出一个盆往里烧纸和元宝，这些东西都是之前给宁楚准备的，后来没用了就一直放在库房里，但现在还是用上了。
火势燃起来后，她就把纸剑和纸衣裳全给丢了进去。
香雾袅袅中，裴昭从灵珠里飘了出来，深深地吸了一口，整只鬼都舒坦开来。
“好香。”裴昭飘在桌边放肆地吸着自己的香火，看到突然出现在桌上的新衣裳和宝剑，高兴不已，当场拿起宝剑耍了起来。
但没耍两招，脑袋就给晃掉了，好不容易才捡起来，他又有点不高兴，“这脑袋怎么老是掉啊，烦死了。”
“阿玖，给我烧点胶水来，我要给它黏在我的脖子上。”
秦玖蹲在火盆边，脸颊被火焰烤得滚烫：“……”
这个想法是不是有点太抽象了？

她要不还是送裴昭去投胎吧。
如此想着，她摇了摇头，算鸟算鸟。
正在此时，客居外响起礼貌的敲门声，她转头一看，发现居然是宁雄霸和宁楚。
秦玖忙不迭站起来身来，“宁宗主，你们来啦？请进。”
裴昭一看到宁雄霸，香火也不吸了，直接躲在秦玖身后，只露出一双眼睛盯着他。
总感觉师尊是冲着自己来的，不太妙。
他决定先服软认错，到时候师尊肯定就不好意思再针对他了，嘿嘿。
“师尊，我刚才只是在跟您开玩笑而已，您这么的英明神武，是不会生气的哦？”
宁雄霸笑笑，“说什么呢，为师岂是那种小气之人，这不是来看你了么？”
“这不，为师还专门给你带了上好的香来。”说着，他从袖中取出三根红色的香，“无论怎么说，为师都该保证你的香火。”
闻言，裴昭眼眸一亮，有些欣喜地从秦玖身后飘了出来，“谢谢师尊，我就知道你最好了。”
“嗯。”宁雄霸理所当然地点点头，那是必须的。
旁边一直没说话的宁楚几不可察地摇了摇头。
她这小师弟还是太单纯了啊。
这种鬼话他也信，他脑子勾芡了吧。
宁雄霸点燃了香，用手扇了扇风，旋即径直插进了茶杯里。
裴昭也是给他面子，毫不犹豫地深吸一口，顷刻间脸色大变，“咳咳，咳咳咳，咳咳咳咳……”
“咳咳，好，好……咳咳咳……好呛……”
content_en:
Who knew he was actually pretending.
"Then dad, how are you going to make it difficult for him?" Ning Chu asked curiously.
He couldn't hit or touch him. Could it be that he was planning to find a Taoist priest to capture Pei Zhao?
Hearing this, Ning Xiongba turned to look at her, with a sinister smile on his lips, and a soft snort escaped from his nose, "Just wait, the immortal has his own clever plan."
Ning Chu: "?"
She showed an expression that was hard to explain. This seemed to be her previous line, right?
How come it’s someone else’s fault now?
It's funny to say that she doesn't have any naughty ideas now. She thinks it's quite boring and it's better to be more mature.
On the contrary, other people seemed to be getting more and more obscene.
Half an hour later, Qin Jiu came to visit.
She asked Gu Xuan for a piece of wood and made a small spiritual tablet for Pei Zhao with her own hands, which was about the size of a palm and suitable for carrying around.
After the burial place was ready, she folded a paper sword out of rice paper, cut out three sets of clothes, and carefully colored the clothes with paint. Finally, she added some soil to the teacup to serve as an incense burner, and then lit three sticks of incense and put it in it.
Immediately, he took out a basin and burned paper and ingots in it. These things were prepared for Ning Chu before. They were kept in the warehouse when they were no longer used, but they are still used now.
After the fire started, she threw all the paper swords and paper clothes into it.
In the mist of fragrance, Pei Zhao floated out from the spirit bead, took a deep breath, and the whole ghost felt relaxed.
"It smells so good." Pei Zhaopiao was inhaling his incense wantonly at the table. When he saw the new clothes and sword that suddenly appeared on the table, he was so happy that he picked up the sword and started playing with it on the spot.
But he didn't do two tricks, and the head fell off. After finally picking it up, he was a little unhappy, "Why does this head keep falling off? It's so annoying."
"Ajiu, burn me some glue and I'll stick it on my neck."
Qin Jiu squatted by the brazier, her cheeks burned by the flames: "..."
Is this idea a bit too abstract?
She might as well send Pei Zhao to be reincarnated.
Thinking like this, she shook her head and counted birds.
At this moment, there was a polite knock on the door outside the guest house. She turned around and found that it was Ning Xiongba and Ning Chu.
Qin Jiu hurriedly stood up and said, "Sect Master Ning, are you here? Please come in."
When Pei Zhao saw Ning Xiongba, he stopped inhaling and hid directly behind Qin Jiu, staring at him with only one pair of eyes exposed.
I always feel that Master is here for me, which is not good.
He decided to admit his mistake first. Then the master would definitely be embarrassed to target him again, hehe.
"Master, I was just joking with you. You are so wise and powerful, you won't be angry, right?"
Ning Xiongba smiled and said, "What are you talking about? I am such a stingy person as a teacher. Isn't this where I come to see you?"
"No, my master has specially brought you good incense." As he said that, he took out three red incense sticks from his sleeves. "No matter what, my master should ensure your incense."
Hearing this, Pei Zhao's eyes lit up and he floated out from behind Qin Jiu with some joy, "Thank you, Master, I knew you were the best."
"Yes." Ning Xiongba nodded naturally, that was necessary.
Ning Chu, who had been silent next to him, shook his head almost imperceptibly.
Her little junior brother is still too naive.
He also believes this kind of nonsense. His mind is thickened.
Ning Xiongba lit the incense, fanned it with his hand, and then put it straight into the tea cup.
Pei Zhao also gave him face, took a deep breath without hesitation, and his face changed drastically in an instant, "Cough cough, cough cough cough, cough cough cough..."
"Ahem, okay, okay... cough, cough, cough... so choking..."
